name: zclass_gwnode_update_all
description: zClass_Class::gwNodeUpdateAll runs sequence updates, animation updates, and queued-tree updates in order and returns the queued-tree update result.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this dispatcher; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass list/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x44ec80 validates the calls to zClass_TypeList::UpdateSequences, zClass_TypeList::UpdateAnimations, and zClass_TypeList::UpdateQueuedTrees, with the queued-tree result returned.
The native smoke verifies that sequence and animation bucket work both run through the dispatcher and that the dispatcher returns success with an empty queued-tree bucket.
